# Cryptocurrency icon subset

Source: https://github.com/spothq/cryptocurrency-icons
License: CC0-1.0, see LICENSE.md. Retrieved 2026-10-26.
The selected SVGs are served locally through brand-icon-data.mjs. Additional asset and exchange marks are documented in ../brand-assets/SOURCE.md; unknown identities use a neutral icon, not a different token logo.

2026-11-02: SOL was replaced with the unchanged official gradient logomark from https://solana.org/pages/branding/logomark/logomark.svg, linked by https://solana.org/branding. It is a Solana trademark used for asset identification, not a CC0 subset asset. The dark backing and clear space are provided by the UI container; artwork paths and colors are unchanged. No endorsement is implied.
